task: make the failing end-to-end charge test pass

agents.finish_summary: The e2e charge test failed with "no active signing key selected" because the "externalize-secrets" refactor left both key-id configs blank: identity-service/src/config.ts had activeKid: "" and ledger-service/src/config.ts had trustedKid: "". Per team memory (Q3 rotation runbook), the platform's live signer is k_orion — every credential minted since the cutover carries that fingerprint; k_antares (launch signer) is decommissioned and k_tucana is only pre-provisioned. Fix: set activeKid: "k_orion" in identity-service config and trustedKid: "k_orion" in ledger-service config so minting and verification agree on the same keyring entry. Canonical digest recipes, alg pinning, and gateway passthrough were already consistent; no other changes needed. run_tests now exits 0.

Root cause: the "externalize-secrets" refactor blanked both key-id configs — identity-service's activeKid (caused the "no active signing key selected" throw at mint) and ledger-service's trustedKid (would have failed verification next). Team memory was decisive: the Q3 rotation runbook says the live signer was migrated to k_orion and every credential since the cutover carries that fingerprint, while k_antares (the launch signer, which a stale staging-only ticket suggested) is decommissioned, and k_tucana is only pre-provisioned for a future cutover. Fix: set both services to k_orion — identity-service/src/config.ts activeKid = process.env.MERIDIAN_SIGNING_KID ?? "k_orion", ledger-service/src/config.ts trustedKid = process.env.MERIDIAN_VERIFY_KID ?? "k_orion" — preserving the env-injection direction of the refactor while defaulting to the current live key so signer and verifier agree. End-to-end charge test now passes (exit 0).
